{{Quote|A few chambers did have some examples of alien artwork&mdash;notably some flatsculps from Breta Yaga and a dancer-sculp from Galloa II&mdash;although they were not as prominently displayed as the other artwork.|Voren Na'al|<ref name="FR">{{WEGCite|story=Field Report|book=The Last Command Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>}}
'''Breta Yaga''' was an astronomical object<ref name="FR" /> located within the [[Breta Yaga system/Legends|Breta Yaga system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Mieru'kar sector/Legends|Mieru'kar sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Several art pieces called [[Flatsculp/Legends|flatsculps]] that were produced by a [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] originated on Breta Yaga. The flatsculps were stored in the [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] complex on the<ref name="FR" /> [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]]<ref name="EAOC Wayland">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Wayland system/Legends|Wayland system]]</ref> planet [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the facility's [[Assault on Mount Tantiss|destruction]]<ref name="FR" /> in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] later mentioned Breta Yaga in<ref name="FR" /> his<ref name="CSWE Na'al">{{CSWECite|II|351|Na'al, Voren}}</ref> [[Voren Na'al's journal|journal]].<ref name="FR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Breta Yaga was first mentioned in "[[Field Report]]," a short segment written from an [[in-universe]] perspective that was published as part of the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]'', authored by [[Eric S. Trautmann|Eric Trautmann]] for the [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="FR" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Breta Yaga [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body Breta Yaga, within grid square O-3.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
